profile.headline: Fullstack Web Developer @ UC Berkeley
profile.summary:
I love building cool, accessible stuff for the web. Both front and back end, or should I say... the full stack.

Currently working to promote inclusion and equity through custom software solutions at UC Berkeley. 

I’ve built some pretty cool things
Check out my portfolio at https://trayecto.dev/projects

positions.title: Lead Developer & CEO
positions.locationName: San Diego, California, United States · Remote
positions.description: Developed and maintained multiple websites, applying advanced development techniques to create custom, visually engaging user interfaces. Conducted comprehensive site audits to ensure adherence to best practices in responsive design and WCAG accessibility standards. Designed and implemented custom JavaScript, PHP and MySQL solutions to extend website capabilities and meet unique client needs.

positions.title: Fullstack Software Engineer - Project Assistant
positions.locationName: San Diego County, California, United States · Hybrid
positions.description: I lead the development of a backend Node.js application. This system was tailored to effectively manage and manipulate career data, enabling school faculty members to allocate specific information to their individual program pages on the school's website. In addition to this, I was also responsible for the creation and upkeep of various web pages for the school's site. My work was consistently completed under tight deadlines, a task made possible through close collaboration with fellow designers and developers.
positions.insights: Skills: RESTful API's · TypeScript · MongoDB · HTML5 · JavaScript · React.js · PHP · Node.js

positions.title: Frontend Software Engineer
positions.locationName: San Diego, California, United States · Remote
positions.description: I aided the creation of a CMS platform by enhancing a drag-and-drop library through custom hook development and implementation. I closely cooperated with backend developers for seamless integration and conducted performance testing on novel features.
positions.insights: Skills: GraphQL · MongoDB · HTML5 · SASS · JavaScript · React.js · Express.js · Node.js · MySQL

positions.title: Audio Video Technician
positions.description: An AV Technicians work involves working to set up audio and video equipment for any event ranging from corporate conferences to large scale concerts and festivals. We work with top of the line commercial equipment to ensure reliability and quality in production.

projects.title: TrayectoAI
projects.description: Unlock your dream career with our AI-powered job hunting platform. From mock interviews and personalized resume guidance to expertly crafted cover letters, we've got you covered. Stay informed every step of the way with real-time insights and statistics on our Job Center dashboard.

projects.title: Portfolio Headless CMS
projects.description: A CMS platform allowing users to update their portfolio content through a dashboard UI using generated API keys and user API endpoints. React.js front end, Node.js/Express back end, and MongoDB and AWS S3 for data storage.

organizations.name: Mesa College Web Development Program's Professional Advisory Committee
organizations.description: I play an active role in shaping the curriculum and steering the program's future. Our committee is all about making sure the program stays in tune with what the industry needs and getting valuable input from our corporate partners. We're committed to building a strong community partnership that addresses the educational needs in web development and really making a difference with our collective insights.
